arguments.text: Brighton are slight favourites to beat Nottingham Forest at home, though the model makes this contest closer than the league baseline would suggest. The standout feature of this fixture is an expectation of low-scoring football: the model gives Under 2.5 goals a 65% probability, well above the 48% league baseline. With expected goals of just 1.02 for Brighton and 0.95 for Forest, both teams to score is rated at only 38%, indicating a likely outcome where one side dominates without necessarily running away with it.
